# Justy Media: Full Site Guide

> A structured overview of the public information and portfolio available at https://www.justymedia.co.uk/.

## Organisation

- Name: Justy Media
- Owner and photographer: Andrew Ambrose
- Established: 2020
- Base: Peak District, United Kingdom
- Specialism: Automotive photography
- Contact: andrew.n.ambrose@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/justymedia/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/justymedia/

Justy Media provides automotive photography with an emphasis on vehicle shape, details, atmosphere, and the surrounding road or location. The portfolio also includes commissioned editorial work for RUSH Magazine. Shoots can be discussed through the contact page.

## Main website sections

### Home

URL: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/

An introduction to Justy Media, recent automotive images, links to portfolio sections, and free phone wallpapers.

### Photography portfolio

URL: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/photography/

The portfolio is divided into two main collections:

- Automotive Photography: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/photography/automotive-photography/
- RUSH Magazine: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/photography/rush-magazine/

### Services and pricing

URL: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/services-pricing.html

The site lists automotive photography options ranging from a basic vehicle sales shoot to single-location and multi-location packages. Prices shown on the website are indicative and enquiries should be confirmed directly with Justy Media.

### Free phone wallpapers

URL: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/phone-wallpapers/

Downloadable automotive images formatted as phone wallpapers. These are presented for use on personal devices; the website's terms continue to apply.

### About and contact

- About Justy Media: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/about-us/
- Contact Justy Media: https://www.justymedia.co.uk/contact-us/

Email is the primary contact method for discussing a shoot, location, requirements, and image ideas.
